# Command line

Every command and option of `stardelt` in this release, generated from its parser (`python/stardelt/cli.json`). How to install it, sign in and combine the commands: [The command line](../guides/cli).

## Options for every command

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--host` | a value | Nova's base URL (default: $STARDELT_NOVA_URL). |

## `stardelt whoami`

Who Nova thinks you are (JSON).

## `stardelt doctor`

Check the host, Nova, the sign-in and who you are; each failure names its fix.

## `stardelt login`

Sign in once with a code approved in a browser (device flow).

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--issuer` | a value | Your identity provider's realm address (default: $STARDELT_ISSUER, else asked from Nova's address). |
| `--client-id` | a value | The public client to sign in with (default: stardelt-dev). |
| `--federated` | — | Sign in with the CI's own token, no browser (a stage's federated client; #57). |
| `--direct` | — | Send the CI token to Nova itself, no provider exchange (a DeployStage verifies it; needs --federated and --host). |
| `--assertion-env` | a value | The environment variable that holds the CI token (default: STARDELT_CI_TOKEN). Default: `STARDELT_CI_TOKEN`. |

## `stardelt logout`

Forget the stored sign-in.

## `stardelt setup`

Install local integration files (the VS Code kernel).

### `stardelt setup vscode`

Write the stardelt kernelspec for VS Code.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--host` | a value | Nova's address (default: STARDELT_NOVA_URL or the stored sign-in). |
| `--spark-host` | a value | The Spark Connect host (default spark.\<Nova's domain\>). |

## `stardelt sql`

Run one statement as you.

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `statement` | The SQL text; or use -f. Optional. |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-f`, `--file` | a value | Read the SQL text from this file, or from standard input when it is -. |
| `--format` | `table`, `json`, `csv` | Default: `table`. |
| `--max-rows` | a value | Print at most N rows (0: all Nova returned). |
| `--long` | — | Run it as a statement: no request stays open, up to 100000 rows, Ctrl-C cancels it in the engine. |

## `stardelt run`

Start a pipeline run now; --wait waits for its end.

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `namespace` |  |
| `name` |  |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--wait` | — | Wait until the run ends; exit 0 only when it succeeded. |
| `--timeout` | a value | With --wait: give up after N seconds (0: no limit); the run is not stopped. |
| `--interval` | a value | With --wait: seconds between two looks (default 5). Default: `5`. |
| `--date` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Run it for this date instead of today; the schedule does not change. |
| `--param` | `NAME=VALUE` | This run's value of the schedule parameter NAME; repeat for more. May be given more than once. |

| `name` |  |

| --- | --- | --- |
| `--catalog` | a value | The catalog to load into (default: the catalog Nova uses for you). |

## `stardelt api`

Call any public operation by its operationId.

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `operation` | An operationId (see --list). Optional. |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--list` | — | List the operations. |
| `-p`, `--path` | `NAME=VALUE` | May be given more than once. |
| `-q`, `--query` | `NAME=VALUE` | May be given more than once. |
| `--body` | a value | The request body, as JSON; @FILE reads it from a file, @- from standard input. |
| `--format` | `json`, `table` | Json (default) or a table when the answer is a list. Default: `json`. |

## `stardelt lineage`

Where a table comes from and what depends on it (upstream and downstream).

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `table` | The table as catalog.schema.table. |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--depth` | a value | How many hops each way (default 2). Default: `2`. |
| `--days` | a value | The time window in days (default 30). Default: `30`. |
| `--upstream` | — | Only the tables it is built from. |
| `--downstream` | — | Only the tables built from it. |
| `--format` | `table`, `json` | Default: `table`. |

## `stardelt mcp`

A local MCP server over the public API.

### `stardelt mcp serve`

Serve the read-only tools on stdio, for an MCP client.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--allow` | `OPERATION_ID` | Also offer this operation (e.g. query_run). May be given more than once. |
| `--no-sql` | — | Leave out the guarded SQL tools sql_read and sql_explain. |

### `stardelt mcp config`

Print how to register the server in an MCP client.

## `stardelt bundle`

Work with a bundle: a directory in Git that describes what a team publishes.

### `stardelt bundle init`

Write a small bundle that passes validate.

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `directory` | Where to write it (default: the current directory). Optional. |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` | a value | The bundle's name (lower-case letters, digits, dashes). Required. |
| `--group` | a value | The group that owns the bundle's pipelines. Required. |

### `stardelt bundle plan`

Ask Nova what deploying one target would do; writes nothing.

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `directory` | The bundle directory (default: the current one). Optional. |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-t`, `--target` | a value | The target to plan (a name under targets in bundle.yaml). Required. |
| `--prune` | — | Also list the pipelines and stream apps of this bundle target that the bundle no longer names. |
| `--accept-drift` | — | Overwrite a pipeline changed after its last deploy even when the target says drift: block. |
| `--adopt` | `NAME` | Take over a pipeline made in Nova (repeatable); without it such a pipeline is refused. May be given more than once. |
| `--diff` | — | Also show, on standard error, what each update would change (the deployed value against the bundle's). |
| `--allow-breaking` | — | Also run migration statements that are not additive (a changed file is always refused). |
| `--format` | `json`, `markdown` | Json: one object per line (default); markdown: a table for a pull request comment. Default: `json`. |

### `stardelt bundle deploy`

Deploy one target: Nova checks every pipeline first, then they are created or updated.

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `directory` | The bundle directory (default: the current one). Optional. |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-t`, `--target` | a value | The target to deploy (a name under targets in bundle.yaml). Required. |
| `--dry-run` | — | The same as `bundle plan`. |
| `--prune` | — | Also remove the pipelines and stream apps of this bundle target that the bundle no longer names. |
| `--accept-drift` | — | Overwrite a pipeline changed after its last deploy even when the target says drift: block. |
| `--adopt` | `NAME` | Take over a pipeline made in Nova (repeatable); without it such a pipeline is refused. May be given more than once. |
| `--diff` | — | Also show, on standard error, what each update changes (the deployed value against the bundle's). |
| `--allow-breaking` | — | Also run migration statements that are not additive (a changed file is always refused). |
| `--smoke` | `NAME` | After the deploy, run this pipeline of the bundle and fail unless it succeeds. |
| `--smoke-timeout` | `SECONDS` | With --smoke: give up waiting after N seconds (0: no limit); the run is not stopped. |
| `--preview` | `ID` | Deploy a preview: every name is prefixed with ID and its schedule is removed (a development target only). |
| `--ttl` | a value | With --preview: how many days the copy lives (1 to 30; default 7). |

### `stardelt bundle approve`

Approve a migration plan that a production deploy needs a second person for.

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `plan_id` | The planId a refused deploy named; the plan's author cannot approve it. |

### `stardelt bundle summary`

Show what a deploy of one target left on the stage: commit, who, when, changed since.

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `directory` | The bundle directory (default: the current one). Optional. |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-t`, `--target` | a value | The target to show (a name under targets in bundle.yaml). Required. |

### `stardelt bundle run`

Start the pipelines a deploy of one target left on the stage and wait for each; stops at the first that fails.

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `directory` | The bundle directory (default: the current one). Optional. |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-t`, `--target` | a value | The target whose pipelines to run (a name under targets in bundle.yaml). Required. |
| `--only` | `NAME` | Run only this pipeline (its name in the bundle, without the dev- prefix). |
| `--timeout` | a value | Give up waiting for a run after N seconds (0: no limit); the run is not stopped. |
| `--interval` | a value | Seconds between two looks at a run (default 5). Default: `5`. |

### `stardelt bundle destroy`

Remove what a deploy of one target put on the stage; lists it first, removes only with --yes.

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `directory` | The bundle directory (default: the current one). Optional. |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-t`, `--target` | a value | The target to empty (a name under targets in bundle.yaml). Required. |
| `--yes` | — | Really remove the pipelines (without it: only list them). |
| `--preview` | `ID` | Remove only the pipelines and streams of this preview (a development target only). |

### `stardelt bundle rollback`

Replay the documents one recorded deployment applied; lists it first, writes only with --yes.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--deployment` | a value | The deployment id to replay (from `stardelt deployments` or the Deployments page). Required. |
| `--yes` | — | Really create and update the pipelines (without it: only check every stored document and list what would change). |

## `stardelt deployments`

Read the deployment record: what each bundle deploy put on a stage.

### `stardelt deployments list`

The newest recorded deploys you may see, newest first.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--bundle` | a value | Only this bundle. |
| `--target` | a value | Only this stage (target). |
| `--format` | `table`, `json` | Default: `table`. |

### `stardelt deployments show`

One recorded deploy: its pipelines and the documents it applied.

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | The deployment id, from `stardelt deployments list`. |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--format` | `table`, `json` | Default: `table`. |
| `--resources` | — | Also print each rendered Pipeline document this deploy applied, one JSON object per line. |

## `stardelt maintenance`

Run a catalog's table maintenance through Trino (used by the operator's nightly job).

### `stardelt maintenance run`

Optimize small files, expire snapshots and remove orphan files for every table of a catalog.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--catalog` | a value | The catalog to maintain (a Trino catalog name). Required. |
| `--policy` | a value | The maintenance policy as JSON (default: $STARDELT_MAINTENANCE_POLICY, else the CRD's defaults). |

## `stardelt skill`

Print the agent skill (SKILL.md); with --write DIR install it.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--write` | `DIR` | Write DIR/stardelt/SKILL.md, for example.claude/skills. |

## `stardelt notebook`

### `stardelt notebook publish`

Publish a notebook as a new version that a schedule can pin.

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `file` | The.ipynb file. |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--group` | a value | The owner group (default: your only group). |
| `--name` | a value | The name in Nova (default: the file name). |

## `stardelt dashboards`

Work with Superset dashboards.

### `stardelt dashboards export`

Write a dashboard as an unzipped Superset export for a bundle; run it inside the bundle (databases/ is not stored).

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `dashboard_id` | The dashboard's Superset id (the number in its URL). |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--out` | `DIR` | The bundle folder to write, for example dashboards/shop. Required. |

### `stardelt dashboards import`

Import a dashboard folder for a bundle's target (the target's databases are remapped).

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `DIR` | The bundle folder to import, for example dashboards/shop. |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--bundle` | `NAME` | The bundle that owns the dashboards. Required. |
| `--owner-group` | `GROUP` | The bundle's owner group. Required. |
| `--target` | `STAGE` | The stage the import is for (dev, prod, …). Required. |
| `--commit` | `SHA` | The commit the bundle was read at, for the provenance stamp. Default: ``. |
| `--overwrite` | — | Replace a dashboard of the same name. |

## `stardelt evals`

The catalog's evals: a question with a known answer, run them or list them.

### `stardelt evals list`

The stored evals of a catalog.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--catalog` | a value | Catalog to read; omitted, the default one. |

### `stardelt evals run`

Ask every eval, run its answer read-only and record pass or fail.

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--catalog` | a value | Catalog to run; omitted, the default one. |
| `--only` | a value | Run one eval by id. |

## `stardelt query-log`

Read Nova's query log: the administrator's export.

### `stardelt query-log export`

Write every row as JSON lines, oldest first (administrator only).

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--out` | a value | The file to write; --cursor and --append add to it, otherwise it is replaced. Required. |
| `--from` | a value | Only rows created at or after this epoch-millisecond time. |
| `--cursor` | a value | The nextCursor a previous, interrupted export named. |
| `--append` | — | Add the rows to the file instead of replacing it. |
| `--limit` | a value | Rows per request, 1 to 1000 (default 500). |

## `stardelt classify`

Suggest a data class for a table's unclassed columns.

### `stardelt classify columns`

Propose a class from each column's name; writes only with --apply.

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `CATALOG.SCHEMA.TABLE` | The table to scan. |

| Option | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--apply` | — | Write the suggestions through the documentation update. |
| `--owner` | `GROUP` | Claim an ownerless table for this group (one of yours). |
